outages.description: Reported damage to infrastructure along National Road 1 caused a complete loss of Internet traffic from Digicel Haiti (AS27653).
Digicel Haiti experiencing damage to its fiber-optic infrastructure along National Highway #1.
An incident on the high-voltage grid disrupted power in Abidjan and other areas, causing a significant drop in Internet traffic across Côte d'Ivoire.
